description:
## New Features

Closes 5 tracking/telemetry findings surfaced by a package-namespace census outside the original 31-SDK checklist:

- **RuTube**: new "Disable Segment analytics" patch no-ops Segment's `Analytics.process(BaseEvent, Continuation)`, the single internal choke point every track/identify/screen/group/alias call funnels through.
- **T-Bank**: new "Disable telemetry worker" patch forces the shared `BaseTelemetryWorker.doWork()` (`ru.tinkoff.core.components.telemetry` on top of OpenTelemetry's disk-buffering exporter) onto an already-proven-safe no-op branch present in the method's own disassembly.
- **VK Video**: new "Disable OpenTelemetry APM" patch forces VK's `ru.ok.tracer`/OpenTelemetry tracing-enabled gate to always return false.
- **T-Bank/Avito/Ozon/Ozon Bank**: new opt-in "Bypass RootBeer root detection" patch nops calls into `RootBeerNative.checkForRoot()` directly (JNI-stable name), defeating root-detection even where the wrapper facade is fully obfuscated.
- **Avito**: wired the existing, already-verified AppMetrica facade disable into Avito's telemetry patch, closing Yandex Varioqub's experiment-bucket reporting which flows through that same facade.

Amplitude (Sberbank) and OpenTelemetry's exception-only remnant (T-Bank) were investigated and confirmed already inert - no patch needed.

All new/changed patches ground-truth verified via dexdump disassembly of the patched output, plus default-only and full-opt-in-forced deep-verify runs with 0 SEVERE on fresh true-original APKs.
